features.name: Ability Score Racial Traits
features.description: At creation choose one physical ability (STR/DEX/CON) for +2, one mental ability (INT/WIS/CHA) for +2, and one ability for −2. Choices must be made individually, not applied to all.

features.name: Size
features.description: Medium creature with no size bonus or penalty.

features.name: Languages
features.description: Begin speaking Common; high-INT optional languages: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin and Orc.

features.name: Variable Resistance
features.description: At character creation, roll 1d6: 1 Earth, 2 Fire, 3 Ice, 4 Lightning, 5 Water, 6 Wind. Gain resistance 5 to exactly the rolled element.

features.name: Spell-Like Ability
features.description: Choose one 1st-level Blue Mage spell, once per day (caster level equals mutant class level). If Blue Mage, gain +2 to Knowledge checks to learn spells.

features.name: Variable Mutant Abilities
features.description: On creation roll 1d100 on the Variant Mutant Abilities table for one result. If a result grants a spell or SLA, caster level is total character level. May additionally roll on the Alternative Physical Features table (1d100). Result 100 instructs further rolls.

features.name: Variable Stats
features.description: At each total character level after 1st, roll 1d6 to grant +1 to one ability (STR,DEX,CON,INT,WIS,CHA). Each score can receive at most +6 from this trait; reroll capped outcomes. Replaces ordinary character-level ability increases at 4/8/12/16/20.

features.name: Low-light Vision
features.description: Twice the human visual range in dim lighting, retaining detail and color.

features.name: Dual Minded
features.description: +2 to all Will saves. Replaces Variable Resistance.

features.name: Eye for Opportunity
features.description: +1 racial attack bonus on attacks of opportunity. Replaces Keen Senses.

features.name: Scavenger
features.description: +2 racial Appraise and Perception checks when finding concealed objects/traps, identifying spoiled food, or tasting potions. Replaces Keen Senses.

features.name: Sociable
features.description: If Diplomacy attempt to improve an attitude fails by 5 or more, may try again before 24 hours elapse. Replaces Keen Senses.

features.name: Variable Defenses
features.description: At each level beyond 1st roll 1d6: 1 +3 HP, 2 +1 MP, 3 +1 Fort, 4 +1 Ref, 5 +1 Will, 6 +1 stackable AC. Each specific benefit maximum five times; reroll capped outcomes. Replaces Variable Stats and normal character-level ability increases at 4/8/12/16/20.

features.name: Wary
features.description: +1 racial to Sense Motive and Bluff. Replaces Keen Senses.

features.name: Alternative Physical Features (Optional)
features.description: Optional separate d100 roll for visible mutant body variation, with multiple-roll instructions for 99 and 100. This is not a replacement for the required mutant ability roll.
